original:
वानप्रस्थाश्रमं प्राप्य तपस्तेपुर्महात्मनः ।
धृतराष्ट्रो महाराजः कुन्ती गान्धारिका तथा ॥
sanskrit:
वानप्रस्थाश्रमं प्राप्य तपस्तेपुर्महात्मनः ।
धृतराष्ट्रो महाराजः कुन्ती गान्धारिका तथा ॥
transliteration:
vānaprasthāśramaṃ prāpya tapas tepur mahātmanaḥ |
dhṛtarāṣṭro mahārājaḥ kuntī gāndhārikā tathā ||
translation: Having embraced the Vanaprastha hermitage order, King Dhritarashtra, Mother Kunti, and Queen Gandhari performed solemn spiritual austerities.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: वानप्रस्थ आश्रम स्वीकार कर महाराज धृतराष्ट्र, माता कुन्ती और गांधारी ने वन में कठोर तपस्या की।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: वानप्रस्थ आश्रम स्वीकारून महाराज धृतराष्ट्र, माता कुंती आणि गांधारी यांनी वनात कठोर तपश्चर्या केली.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The elders renounce the imperial capital to seek spiritual purification through silent asceticism in the forest.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: Illustrates the traditional Hindu lifecycle requirement of dispassion and forest contemplation before bodily departure.
